modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On June 17, 2021: Juneteenth National Independence Day is signed into law by President Joe Biden, to become the first federal holiday established since Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 1983.

On June 17, 1985: Space Shuttle program: STS-51-G mission: Space Shuttle Discovery launches carrying Sultan bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, the first Arab and first Muslim in space, as a payload specialist.
On June 17, 1967: Nuclear weapons testing: China announces a successful test of its first thermonuclear weapon.
June 17 is observed as Occupation of the Latvian Republic Day (Latvia).

image_credit.author: former image original uploader was Irpen at en.wikipedia

did_you_know.fact: June 17 is observed as Father's Day (El Salvador, Guatemala).
